r2Reimplementation.correctedRootCause: findOwnedImage(imageId) compared two values both derived from the same resolved row (ImagingImage.clinicId vs its own ImagingStudy.clinicId) — a self-consistency check, never a caller-tenant check. Fixed by giving every imageId-only method an explicit clinicId parameter and applying it as a query-level predicate on both ImagingImage and ImagingStudy, so a cross-tenant row returns zero rows at the database level.
